- **AutoSelect**: automatic selection.
- **ManualSelect**: manual selection.

The protocol used by the internal network access application. Valid values:

title.en: Create an internal network diagnostic task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas create-pa-diagnosis-task --diagnose-type FullLink --username Zhaosi --dev-tag 2987b3e0-8108-2f99-4d18-3b4f1c1c36d7 --user-group-id '用户组ID。' --protocol TCP --host socialapp-gateway.client9.me --port 80 --pop-mode ManualSelect --pop-id pop-3e244b62357dcafc --udp-extra-configs RequestContent=hello ExpectedResponse=hello --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas CreatePADiagnosisTask --region cn-hangzhou --UdpExtraConfigs '{"RequestContent":"hello","ExpectedResponse":"hello"}' --Username Zhaosi --UserGroupId '用户组ID。' --Port 80 --PopId 'pop-3e244b62357dcafc' --DevTag '2987b3e0-8108-2f99-4d18-3b4f1c1c36d7' --Host 'socialapp-gateway.client9.me' --DiagnoseType FullLink --Protocol TCP --PopMode ManualSelect
